={{ JSON.stringify({
  title: `[Sigma Review] FP Suppression Rule: ${$json.file_name}`,

    'This rule was generated by the SOAR feedback loop after 10 confirmed false-positive denials.',
    '**Review before merging** — a too-broad rule can suppress genuine attack detection.',
    '',
    '### Rule Content',
    '```yaml',
    $node['Read Sigma YAML Content'].json.stdout,
    '```',
    '',
    '### Review Checklist',
    '- [ ] Pattern is specific enough to only suppress the benign FP pattern',
    '- [ ] Rule does NOT suppress legitimate attack indicators',
    '- [ ] Rule has been tested in dev SIEM before merging',
    '- [ ] MITRE coverage gap has been assessed'
  ].join('\n'),
  head: `sigma-auto/${$json.file_name.replace('.yml','')}`,
  base: 'main',
  draft: false
}) }}
